findings.detail: The required forward/backward check could not execute in this environment because importing torch fails; therefore finite loss/gradients and gradient reach are not independently verified. Static inspection shows the smoke test checks only that some parameter has a gradient, not that intended parameters all receive gradients.
findings.reproduction: From the candidate tree, run `python smoke_test.py`; it exits at line 4 with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'torch'`.
findings.correction: Run the smoke test in the project's configured PyTorch environment and confirm finite loss and gradients on the intended trainable parameters; report the resulting evidence. No source-level numerical defect was established by inspection.
